description: Three opposition parties announced a nationwide rally for 8 October, describing government failures and the need for a new national government (S009, S010). Searches in English, Armenian, and Russian, including date-specific and news-feed queries, did not locate a contemporaneous account proving whether it occurred, its attendance, or its actual demands. This is unresolved occurrence, not evidence of cancellation or nonoccurrence.
required_followup: Check accessible contemporaneous 8 October local broadcast/newspaper archives and organizer reports for actual gathering, attendance, and demands; preserve no-report as a limitation if still unresolved.

description: Candidate E001 is a reported 16 October march in Yerevan, but the source provides no crowd estimate and does not state whether the demand was directed at Armenia’s government or only foreign missions/international policy.
required_followup: Find a contemporary account stating the route/addressees and participant count or clear threshold evidence.

description: The 16 October Yerevan march and UN-office protest are reported separately by different sources. Whether the groups/actions were connected, and the march’s exact beginning or wider campaign end, is not established. No verified cross-month continuation starting before October was identified for these records.
required_followup: Compare dated local reporting, photos/video and organizer descriptions without merging on date/location alone; query later-month records for an explicit continuation.

description: Open-web searching is not equivalent to LexisNexis or the project’s original archive. Search-engine date operators and completeness are unverified. Coverage included 44 actual English, Armenian, and Russian query submissions: 38 retained result/header sets and six output losses, with weekly windows, event follow-up, and limited regional/sector/continuity searches. Local and regional coverage can still be missing.
required_followup: If authorized archives become available, run the original source/time procedure and compare candidate coverage. Until then, retain coverage as incomplete.

description: The official baseline, country universe, schema, and exact country-code mapping were not supplied or verified. The supplied May 2015 manual is available; Armenia ccode remains null.

description: The excluded foreign-target actions have incomplete attendance, exact event scope, close date, and state-response details. Those fields remain unknown; search silence is not coded as no response. Some announcements and video reports are search-only, not body-read.
